abstention.policy: Non-retrieval queries must abstain from currentness claims and expose the sealed observation cutoff / release pin when required. This fixture evaluation is not a live canary and does not emit live legal advice.

acceptance.criteria: Sealed thresholds and differential references pass; traversal, tamper, digest, decompression, budget, mutable-revision, and secret tests fail closed; no fixture result is called a live canary.

bm25.selection_reason: plan default k1=1.2 b=0.75 multi-field weights

fusion.selection_reason: selected on sealed dev split by primary hybrid recall, then MRR, then nDCG@10; test split is not used for selection

vector.embedding_note: Fixture vectors use the local deterministic projection for offline parity; production GTE-small identity is declared by the vector receipt and cannot be authorized by this gate.

currentness_disclaimer: Acquisition and publication timestamps record when a Federal Register package was retrieved or sealed; they are not a claim that the document is legally current as of wall-clock time. Retrieval output is a research aid and is not a substitute for the official FederalRegister.gov or GovInfo source. Time-sensitive gold queries must expose the observation cutoff / release pin rather than imply currentness.

fusion_selection.reason: selected on sealed dev split by primary hybrid recall, then MRR, then nDCG@10; test split is not used for selection

sparse.notes: I/O uses a deterministic synthetic cost model so sealed reports are wall-clock independent. Routed queries must select a proper subset of shards and stay under the declared byte/shard ratios.

production_claim.claim: NO production-searchable claim: fixture uses local deterministic projection, not live GTE-small; fixture evaluation is not a live canary and does not authorize Hub upload.

reference_hardware.notes: Sealed offline evaluation uses a deterministic synthetic cost model; numbers are comparable across commits on this fixture, not absolute production SLAs for arbitrary hardware.

reference_network.notes: LCR-063 fixture evaluation never contacts the network. Remote Hub byte budgets for live staging/canary are deferred to LCR-064 and must not be inferred from this report.

resources.notes: Peak memory and build throughput are synthetic fixture estimates for regression tracking; they are not measured OS samples.
